content.title: Home Builders’ Stocks Are Falling. Why Wall Street’s Most Bullish Analyst Just Backed Off.
content.summary: While there still aren’t enough homes in the U.S. for everyone who would want to own one, that isn’t going to help builders, says Evercore analyst Stephen Kim.  “I’m here to tell you now that we have a housing deficit—but the deficit does not allow the builders to build a lot more houses unless you want home prices to fall.”  Mortgage rates have come down from their 2025 highs of around 7%, yet buyers have remained few and far between.
